hits.title: In-Situ Announces Agreement to be Acquired by Veralto
hits.snippet: The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2026 following customary closing considerations, after which In-Situ will join OTT HydroMet as part of Veralto’s Water Quality segment. The partnership combines In-Situ’s nearly 50 years of innovation in groundwater and surface-water monitoring with Veralto’s global reach and leadership in water quality. Christopher McKee, Chairman of In-Situ, said: “As I reflect on In-Situ’s journey and this next exciting chapter with Veralto, I’m filled with gratitude for the extraordinary people who have poured their talent and passion into this company. Today, we carry their legacy forward, joining Veralto in a powerful combination that will accelerate our global growth and deliver even stronger solutions to protect the environment and improve lives around the world.” [EC M&A](https://www.ec-ma.com/) served as exclusive financial advisor to In-Situ on this transaction.
